{% autoescape off %}# Gabriel Accioly (oAccioly) · oAccioly Faz

> Gabriel Accioly, who signs online as oAccioly, is a full-stack software engineer from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, with a Forward Deployed Engineer profile: he works inside the client's operation and ships software that runs in production. He has been programming since 2017, founded the retail SaaS Diapasão, builds the products of Kaya Mind, and takes on projects through his company, oAccioly Faz (OACCIOLY FAZ LTDA, Pouso Alegre, MG, Brazil).
